notes.title: MF-01 Aerostrike - Version 2.1.0.0
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43646990/5c2f74c59ea06cc1fb40953d206ce299a0e7b4b3.png

We interrupt your daily flight to bring you a new patch. It's been a while, huh? Good news is that I've got some stuff cooking, bad news is that it'll take a while. However, I was able to import some of that new stuff straight into MF-01 Aerostrike here in version 2.1.0!

The main feature of this patch is new and improved Gamepad Aiming controls! The old system was... extra-rough, forcing the crosshairs to a set distance and having to pivot it around the ship, which made the camera movement quite odd as a result. The new system fixes all of this.

Now, when aiming with a Gamepad, the crosshairs will move further away the more you push the aiming stick. Additionally, when not aiming, the crosshairs will reset back to the position the Aerostrike is moving in, allowing players to navigate without having to aim all the time.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43646990/719f6bff658fceabba013bb20b60a8205bafa593.png

As a bonus, there's also new settings in the Options menu to adjust all of these new features, or even retain the better parts of the old system. Feel free to play around with them and see what fits your playstyle better, and let me know if there's anything that doesn't seem to be working quite right yet.

Here's a full list of patch notes:

Balance:

 Increased the rotation speed of most ships while using a Gamepad.
	> The new aiming system prevents most cases of jittery camera movement caused by moderate rotation speeds.


Additions:

 Added a new Free Paintjob: Digistrike.
 Added a new Free Paintjob: Perseverance.
	> You can swap to them in the Shipyard or in the Options menu.


Campaign:

 Adjusted the spawn positions of enemies in the Base Barracks room in Area 3.


Options:

 "Gamepad Options 2" -> "Rotation Speed" renamed to "Aim Sensitivity".
	> It now controls how fast the Crosshair moves.
 "Aiming" -> "Distance" renamed to "Maximum Distance".
	> It now controls how far the Crosshair can move from the ship when aiming.
 Added new Aiming setting, "Minimum Distance".
	> It controls how close the Crosshair can move to the ship when not aiming.
 Added new Aiming setting, "Reset Cursor".
	> It controls if the Crosshair will match the ship's movement direction when not aiming.
	> Set to 0.0 for instant reset, or a higher value to add a brief pause before resetting.
 "Aiming" -> "Placement" setting has been removed.
	> The difference it had in camera control was minimal, and I also forgot how it was supposed to work.


Bugs:

 Fixed Aim Assist not working on ships in Rebel Ops and Hel's Fighters.


Techical Changes:

 Modified the movement and aiming system for Gamepad.
	> The Crosshair now moves further away when aiming, and closer when not aiming.
	> By default, the Crosshair will match the ship's movement direction when not aiming.
	> This reset by default has a brief pause of 1 second, adjustable in the Options menu.
 Modified the terrain collision code to allow ships to "slide off" edges.
	> Only works if the middle if the ship is not touching a solid surface.
	> How well a ship slides depends on its shape and speed.
 Updated the Input library to version 8.1.3.


If anyone is met with any sort of weird bug feel free to leave a comment, send an email to the support address, or make a post in either of the Steam support threads for MF-01 Aerostrike.

Stay safe pilots!

notes.title: Patch Notes - Version 2.0.0
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43646990/ef8ad6541fdad33ae00eb613e6bbc23cc3bbad20.png

We interrupt your daily flight to bring you a new patch. Sorry I'm late with this one, a lot has happened in the past few months. However, here it is, MF-01 Aerostrike 2.0! While it's not a sequel, it's a huge patch that somehow lowered the game's total file size.

The biggest change was a major overhaul of the game's visuals. Walls across the game were updated to brand new assets, handcrafted over a whole month, and manually placed on each room and area. Hopefully this improves on the previously lacking visuals of the game.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43646990/5ca8d46fe25b0e66c3d42148af01d7cf5e66f9b8.png

Additionally, the Bindings system was also improved. Now you can adjust all game bindings to whatever you wish! It will also import the bindings stored in the old system, so (hopefully) there's no need to rebind everything.

Other than that, an aim-assist system has been added to the game! It can be adjusted in the Options menu, or turned off altogether. There's also a lot of game optimizations across the board, from a new enemy loot drop system, to the Shipyard not requiring scaled up versions of each ship.

I'm expecting a few things to break, despite my best efforts to double-check everything, so please report any issues you stumble across!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43646990/99d28122be1575f1a2265d9a6dd73fd53106fa00.png

Here is a full list of patch notes:

Balance:

 Rockets will now lock onto targets within a small frontal arc.
 Reworked the pickup drop system.
 Enemy drop rates have been increased across the board.


Additions:

 Added an aim-assist system to help players aim at enemies.
	> Its strength can be adjusted in the Options menu.


Visuals:

 Disabled Linear Interpolation.
 Modified all fonts to work as SDF fonts.
 Modified most walls and all background walls of the game.
 Buttons and Window backgrounds are now darker.
 Updated the pixel art of all background decorations.
 Updated the pixel art of all rockets and missiles.
 Added ship wreckages to rooms where a big fight takes place.
 Turrets will now flip around when looking towards the left.
 Tutorial text now displays control icons instead of text.


Campaign:

 Added an extra dock in the Lower Hub of Area 2.
 Relocated Area 3's Lobby dock to the entrance room.
 Replaced the old Area 3's Dock room with a container storage.
 Minor wall layout changes to multiple rooms across the Campaign.
 Modified various fights across the game.
 Modified the Door power arrangement in Area 7.
 Relocated a Door Blocker in Area 7 to a better position.


Options:

 Added Fullscreen Borderless as a display setting in Video Options.
 Replaced Keyboard and Gamepad option menus with Bindings and Controls.
	> In Bindings, you can rebind all the controls of the game to your preference.
	> The game will automatically import any bindings stored from the old system.
	> In Controls, you'll find various settings for Keyboard, Mouse, and Gamepad.
 Added separate deadzone settings for left and right analog sticks.
 Added separate threshold settings for left and right Gamepad triggers.
 Added aim assist strength settings to the new Aiming section of the Controls menu.
 Removed various Gamepad and Mouse Wheel Scrolling settings that are now obsolete.
 Modified the default values of various option settings to better alternatives.


Bugs:

 Fixed being unable to unpause the game by pressing "ESC".
 Fixed the Forward/Reinforced Shield lagging behind when moving the ship.
 Fixed the Laser Beam not following the Aerostrike correctly.


Techical Changes:

 Updated the Input library to version 8.0.2.
 Moved physical walls to be in front of gameplay objects.
 Moved all text draw calls to the GUI layer to work with SDF features.
 Modified the Shipyard sprite display system to reuse existing ship assets.
 Modified the Behemoth fight code to work more efficiently.
 Modified the Map Mark text to a simplified form, and to display the binding as an icon.
 Removed lots of unused and obsolete sprite assets.
 Rebuilt the Fade-In/Out system to work with the new SDF text.
 Slightly optimized the Map movement system.
 Slightly optimized the Display reset system, used when adjusting Video settings.


If anyone is met with any sort of weird bug feel free to leave a comment, send an email to the support address, or make a post in either of the Steam support threads for MF-01 Aerostrike.

Stay safe pilots!

notes.title: Patch Notes - Version 1.5.2
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43646990/ad63bface574033acb76ff7a0522991cac8e28e4.png

We interrupt your daily flight to bring you a new patch. It improves the code for the Regular and Quick Map, and also adds a lot of optimization and technical changes. While a lot of changes have been made, they can be summed up quickly.

First off, the Map generation code has been optimized. Additionally, it received a few Quality-of-Life modifications. The Quick Map now accurately displays unopenned doors, and doors that can only be opened with a Laser Beam are marked differently to the ones that require Rockets.

On the more technical side of things, a new idle animation system was implemented. Not only does it run more smoothly, it also lets me remove a lot of redundant assets, making the game slightly slimmer. It even allows me to add idle animations to enemy ships!

Finally, one of the most important changes is that a new free paintjob has been added to the game, called Carol. Its main feature is a cute little christmas hat on top! Unfortunately it doesn't offer jiggle physics, as I'm yet to figure out how to do those.

Here is a full list of patch notes:

Additions:

 Added a new Free Paintjob: Carol.
	> You can swap to it in the Shipyard or in the Options menu. 


Visuals:

 Secret Doors are now painted green instead of gray on the map.
 Removed Secret Doors from the map key, as they act just like regular doors.
 Added a new Map icon: Sealed.
	> This icon marks doors held shut by a special sealing lock.
 The Quick Map now accurately indicates which doors have been used before.
 Enemy ships now have an idle animation when Idle or Alert.


Campaign:

 Increased the activation arc of the Centurion's Forward Shield from 10 degrees up to 90 degrees.
	> It's mostly to deal with a rare issue with the Forward Shield.
	> Shouldn't have any tangible impact on the fight itself.


Rebel Ops:

 Reduced the number of Paladins that spawn in Mission 6.


Bugs:

 Fixed several Dock icons being incorrectly tinted.
 Fixed an incorrect objective marker in Rebel Ops Mission 6.
 Fixed a bug where using a specific secret door in Rebel Ops didn't make it appear on the map.
 Fixed the Hel's Fighters Store map room displaying a Landing Pad instead of a dock.
 Fixed enemy projectile sounds stacking during the last two phases of the final boss.


Techical Changes:

 Updated the Input library to version 6.1.5.
 Optimized the Map creation code.
 Optimized the persistent enemy code.
 Optimized the enemy lead calculation code.
 Created a new idle animation system for the game.
 Removed the now unused idle animation sprites.
 Removed several obsolete objects.
 Removed several unnecessary lines from the final stats window after finishing Hel's Fighters.
 Removed several obsolete functions from the code.


Steam-exclusive Changes (does not affect non-Steam releases):

 Updated the achievement icons for all Hel's Fighters achievements.


This is currently the last planned update for MF-01 Aerostrike. From here on, patches might be simple bug fixes or maybe a few extra free paintjobs. I'm looking to work on other projects for the time being, including a possible short Potatostrike SHMUP game.

If anyone is met with any sort of weird bug, or simply thinks that the map should have inverted controls, feel free to leave a comment, send an email to the support address, or make a post in either of the Steam support threads for MF-01 Aerostrike.

Stay safe pilots!

notes.title: Patch Notes - Version 1.5.1
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43646990/4c71ac4b6f81fa52fdec1c4403f8205c4c550f4e.png

We interrupt your daily flight to bring you a new patch. FINALLY! The patch was ready on Tuesday, but internal problems with Steam kept me from releasing the patch. But hey, it's all fixed now!

Anyways, back to the patch. It adds the Hel's Fighters section of the Story menu, and rebalances the final bossfight to a more reasonable level. It also fixes a variety of bugs and adds some QoL features.

The new Hel's Fighters lore entries include information on various topics. From its origins, to the staff that runs the show, the arenas, and the various Champions. There's a total of 20 entries to read. Feel free to give me your opinions!

Onto the next topic, the final boss of the campaign had multiple aspects changed to make the fight less difficult and more entertaining, especially at lower difficulties. Several bugs that made the fight harder than intended were also patched out.

Finally, several QoL changes were added. The Quick Map now remains open when you switch between rooms. This should make active navigation easier. The feature is built into the game, so no need to mess with Option settings this time around.

Here is a full list of patch notes:

Balance:

 Decreased the damage thresholds required to advance to the next phase of the final bossfight.
 Decreased the final boss's weapon range from (1000, 800, 500) down to (800, 650, 500).
	> The order represents (long range, medium range, short range) respectively.
 Decreased the amount of time the final boss uses Long Range loadouts from 15 seconds down to 10 seconds.
 Decreased the final boss's bullet dodge range for long range loadouts from (150, 200, 250, 300) down to (75, 100, 125, 150).
	> Due to a coding error, the bullet dodge range was locked to 300 acrosss all difficulties.
 Decreased the unshielded health regeneration of the final boss from (1.0, 1.0, 1.0, 1.0) down to (0.4, 0.6, 0.8, 1.0).
 Decreased the base turn rate of the Blue Disruptor Missiles from (3.0, 3.5, 4.0, 4.5) down to (2.1, 2.9, 3.7, 4.5).
 The Blue Disruptor Missile Burst was replaced with a giant Disruptor Missile that explodes and releases 5 Blue Disruptor Missiles.
	> Should give players a heads-up to prepare for missiles, or to quickly destroy the big one with a Manual Detonation.


Visuals:

 Interface terminals now have an animated "..." when there's more text to display.
 Blue Disruptor Missiles now glow to make them stand out from other projectiles.
 Modified the impact particle of Blue Disruptor Missiles to better indicate when they impacted the player.
	> If they didn't directly impact the player, it will appear as a normal missile explosion.
	> If they hit the player directly, it will appear as a large, blue EMP explosion.


Audio:

 Added a sound to Carriers launching Sentries and Drones.


Campaign:

 Adjusted the barrier text in the R&D Admin Landing Pad to give better information.
 Slightly reduced the numbers of Knights and Hunters in one specific fight sequence in Chapter 3.
 Removed a wave of Hunters at the end of one specific battle in Chapter 3.
 Adjusted the A.R.I.A. help text for the final boss.


Demo:

 Slightly decreased the number of Wrestlers and Spinners that spawn in a specific fight on Area 3 of the Demo map.


Story:

 Added a new section for Hel's Fighters story.
	> It includes information on its origins, staff, arenas, and Champions.


Bugs:

 Fixed a bug where several objective markers in Area 2 triggered earlier than intended.
 Fixed a bug where an objective marker in Area 5 triggered earlier than intended.
 Fixed a bug where the Behemoth's turrets would not appear destroyed if killed during a phase swap.
 Fixed a bug where the Conqueror could get stuck inside the player when using the Energy Spike.
 Fixed a bug where the Conqueror's bullet dodge range was not adjusting for difficulty.
 Fixed a bug where no button would be selected while trying to browse the Rebel Ops menu with a gamepad.
 Fixed several Challenge typos.
 Fixed an issue where firing sounds did not correctly adjust based off distance to the player.
	> Sounds too far away for the player to hear were still being played.


Techical Changes:

 The Quick Map now remains open when switching rooms.
 Improved enemy projectile handling during specific phase switches during the final boss.


If anyone is met with any sort of weird bug, or simply thinks that the final boss should be tougher than before, feel free to leave a comment, send an email to the support address, or make a post in either of the Steam support threads for MF-01 Aerostrike.

Stay safe pilots!

notes.title: Patch Notes - Version 1.5.0
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43646990/2caf2728173b153bcd1bb861ca7b5b0e2a8999ba.png

We interrupt your daily flight to bring you a new patch. It adds the last portion of the Hel's Fighters gamemode, and concludes the story. There is also a New Game+ option for those that wish to stay in the arena for a while longer.

Additionally, new Hel's Fighters Challenges/Achievements and unlockable paintjobs have been added. There are 14 in total, and can be completed in your first playthrough or in New Game+. You can review the new tasks on the Challenge menu.

Finally, a few balance changes have been made to Hel's Fighters. The Sentinel Zero fight was reworked to be more interesting, High Explosive Shells now increases the Gladiator's damage, and Machinist and a handful of her drones got tiny improvements as well.

Here is a full list of patch notes:

Additions:

 Added a new Free Paintjob: Gift.
	> You can swap to it in the Shipyard or in the Options menu.


Hel's Fighters:

 Added Days 9-12 to Hel's Fighters.
 Added a New Game+ option, unlocked after completing Hel's Fighters on that save file.
 High Explosive Shells now also increases the impact damage of the Gladiator's 37mm Cannons by 10 across the board.
 Reworked the Sentinel Zero fight.
	> His primary weapon now always fires an accurate burst of plasma.
	> His secondary weapon now always fires Seeker Missiles.
	> After the first phase, he'll start using special attacks every 5 seconds.
	> After the second phase, his special attacks become slightly stronger.
 Decreased the time it takes for Machinist to replenish her drones from (10, 10, 10, 10) seconds down to (9, 8, 7, 6) seconds.
 Increased the burst length of Strike Drones escorting Machinist from (3, 3, 3, 3) rounds up to (3, 4, 5, 6) rounds.
 Increased the flight speed of Quad Drones from 4 up to 6.


Shipyard:

 Added 14 new Hel's Fighters paintjobs.
	> They must be unlocked first by completing its respective Challenge.

	
Challenge:

 Added 14 new Hel's Fighters challenges.


Bugs:

 Fixed a bug that caused Rotating Shields to be immune to projectile damage.
	> They should only be immune to laser and explosive damage.
 Fixed a bug that caused the Ghastly paintjob to not be correctly displayed in the Shipyard.


Steam-exclusive Changes (does not affect non-steam releases):

 Added 14 new Achievements for the Hel's Fighters gamemode.
	> They are currently using placeholder images. They will be changed at a later date.


If anyone is met with any sort of weird bug, or simply thinks that the last couple of fights need to be tougher, feel free to leave a comment, send an email to the support address, or make a post in either of the Steam support threads for MF-01 Aerostrike.

Stay safe pilots!

notes.title: Patch Notes - Version 1.4.6
notes.notes:
​{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43646990/7162b6d6d704f949cb66a458e3d331ecc6f16160.png

We interrupt your daily flight to bring you a new patch. This Quality-of-Life patch reworks many of the battles across the Campaign to improve the experience. It also rebalances several weapons, enemies, and enemy weapons!

Version 1.4.6 also adds a few new backgrounds to various rooms, in hopes of slightly improving the visuals of the world. Additionally, several new UI elements have been added to give the player useful feedback and information.

Finally, this patch also adds a camera smoothing setting in the Options menu, inside the Interface submenu. This feature should help pilots who have to deal with motion sickness. Do let me know if it helps or not, that way the system can be adjusted accordingly!

Here is a full list of patch notes:

Balance:

 Increased the 23mm Cannon's damage against armor from 15 up to 18.
 Decreased the 23mm Cannon's heat generation from 0.5 down to 0.4.
 Increased the Energy Cannon's damage against shields from 36 up to 40.
 Increased the upgraded Energy Cannon's explosion damage against shields from 24 up to 25.
 Increased the detonation distance of the Flak Shotgun from 100 pixels up to 125.
 Decreased the fire rate of the Railgun Cannon from 120 RPM down to 103 RPM.
 Hyper Capacitor no longer increases damage against ship hulls, only against armor.
 Decreased the fire rate of the upgraded Railgun Cannon from 144 RPM down to 120 RPM.
 Increased the turn speed of enemy Seeker Missiles from (0.5, 1.0, 1.5, 2.0) up to (0.8, 1.2, 1.6, 2.0).
 Titans now stop shooting very briefly after firing 30 bullets in a row.
 Increased the projectile leading accuracy of the Javelin.
 Increased the fire radius of the Javelin from 4 degrees up to 16 degrees.
 Modified the enemy Flak weapons to spread out into a fixed pattern, rather than a random one.
 Modified the collision code of all enemies with boost thrusters to reliably fly through the player.
	> The previous code would sometimes cause the AI get stuck inside the player.
	> Enemies like the Stinger would then deal massive damage while inside the player's hitbox.
	> This new code allows them to properly clip through the player and fly away.
	> This does not affect cases where a Stinger will pin you to a wall, so fly carefully.
	> This also causes ships like the Stinger to slightly spread out while flying.
 Increased the projectile leading accuracy of the Orca.
 Increased the rotation speed of the Hetz from (3.0, 3.5, 4.0, 4.5) up to (3.5, 4.0, 4.5, 5.0).
 Increased the boost rotation speed of the Hetz from (1.0, 1.5, 2.0, 2.5) up to (1.5, 2.0, 2.5, 3.0).
 Decreased the total amount of enemy ships spawned by the Behemoth.
 The Behemoth now has a visual and audio cue when calling reinforcements.
 Set the time required for the Behemoth to call reinforcements at 10 seconds regardless of difficulty.
	> For some reason, the timer was shorter on lower difficulties. I don't know why, but oh well.


Additions:

 Added a new Free Paintjob: Ghastly.
	> You can swap to it in the Shipyard or in the Options menu.


Visuals:

 Added a few new backgrounds to a handful of rooms.
 Added Area indicators whenever you enter a new section of the map.
 Map Icons are no longer tinted.
 Armored Wall generators now have a blinking animation.
 Container interior backgrounds no longer inherit the color of the area.
 Removed a few Foreground Walls in Area 3 of the Campaign.
 Added a few extra doodads to a handful of rooms in the Campaign.
 Machine walls are no longer tinted.


Campaign:
 Modified multiple objective markers across the Campaign.
 Modified enemy spawns on multiple battles across the Campaign.
 Added a new helpful transmission in Chapter 1.
 A door that locked inside the Factory after entering its room now remains open.
 Added a rocket pickup to a specific room in Area 2 to avoid a softlock situation.


Hel's Fighters:

 The Bomber's Bomblets no longer destroy shield walls.
	> This was a feature accidentally left over from early testing.
 Reworked the Stealth Mines.
	> Enemies can no longer collide with them, which destroyed the mine without causing an explosion.
	> They are now deployed active, instead of having a 1 second delay.
	> When an enemy approaches them, they will become armed.
	> After 0.5 seconds, armed Stealth Mines will explode.
	> If there are no enemies nearby, the explosion will be aborted.
 Replaced the Store Landing Pad with a Docking Bay.
	> This means you can now swap ships inside the store!


Training:

 The Training Room no longer resets after exiting.


Options:

 Added a Camera Smoothing setting in the Interface menu.
	> It adjusts how much the camera eases in-and-out of movement.
	> Increase the value to make the camera accelerate slower.
 All keybinds are set by default now. This helps fix a rare crash where a null keybind was detected.


Bugs:

 Fixed a Map Room in Area 2 of the Campaign incorrectly displaying a door as Blocked.
 Fixed various Map Rooms in Area 2 of the Campaign incorrectly displaying doors as Open.
 Fixed a Map Room in Area 4 of the Campaign incorrectly displaying a door as Locked.
 Fixed a bug that caused the Background of the Area 4 hangars to not move correctly.
 Fixed an object in Area 5 of the Campaign not disappearing correctly.
 Fixed the long corridor in the Hel's Fighters map not connecting correctly to the main hub.
 Fixed the broken Capslock key text.
 Fixed Black Screen Transitions briefly locking mouse controls.
 Fixed Upgrade pop-ups briefly locking mouse controls.
 Fixed a minor issue with the Hel's Fighters thousands separator.
 Fixed a bug that prevented the Alliance paintjob from being correctly displayed in the transmission window.


Techical Changes:

 Added a tiny 2-frame cooldown when scrolling through weapons.
	> It should hopefully make swapping weapons with a mouse scroll wheel easier.
	> Button swapping should remain unaffected, as the cooldown is extremely short.
 Updated the Input library to version 6.1.2.
 Moved a piece of equipment in the Campaign so it's not hidden behind the UI.
 Slightly optimized the collision code for enemies.
 Various minor text modifications and typo fixes.
 Removed multiple duplicate map sprites.
 The Behemoth will now automatically destroy any turrets "dying" after its own weakpoint has been destroyed.
	> This should prevent issues where the turrets don't die fast enough, and the game turned them invincible.


If anyone is met with any sort of weird bug, or simply thinks that the balance changes didn't hit their mark, feel free to leave a comment,  send an email to the support address, or make a post in either of the Steam support threads for MF-01 Aerostrike.

Stay safe pilots!

notes.title: Patch Notes - Version 1.4.5
notes.notes:
​We interrupt your daily flight to bring you a new patch. This minor patch slightly modifies the Stinger and the Hetz, two enemies that have been causing pilots everywhere a little more trouble than intended. The Hetz received the most changes overall.

Version 1.4.5 also fixes multiple reported issues, two crashes, and some bosses having more combat dialogue than intended. It also adds a gamepad functionality to detonate rockets with the same button used to launch them. If anyone wants this change on Keyboard & Mouse, let me know.

Finally, a lot of slight visual modifications were made across the game. Background colors are more saturated, and the map has more clearly defined colors for each area too. The background vignette was also changed into an ellipse shape instead of a rounded rectangle.

Here is a full list of patch notes:

Balance:

Note 1: All values are for (Trial Run, Standard Test, Stress Test, Trial by Fire), respectively.
Note 2: The Hetz boosts when traveling, and flies normally while attacking.
 Decreased the boost rotation speed of the Stinger from (1, 2, 3, 3) down to (0.5, 1.5, 2.5, 2.5).
 Decreased the damage of the Stinger's Energy Spike from (2, 4, 6, 8) down to (1, 3, 5, 7).
 Decreased the boost speed of the Hetz from (16, 19, 19, 19) down to (16, 17, 18, 19).
 Decreased the boost rotation speed of the Hetz from (5, 6, 6, 6) down to (3, 3.5, 4, 4.5).
 Decreased the rotation speed of the Hetz from (3, 4, 4, 4) down to (1, 1.5, 2, 2.5).
 Increased the hitbox size of the Behemoth's Generators.

	
Main Menu:

 Added a button to change the language.
	> You can freely swap between English and Spanish.


Visuals:

 Modified the background Vignette to have an ellipse shape instead of a rounded rectangle.
 Modified the background colors of each Area in the game.
 Modified the colors of each Area in the map.


Campaign:

 Added an item locator to a Landing Pad Interface on Chapter 5.
	> When turned on, it will mark every room in the game that has a collectible item.
	> It is entirely optional, and can be turned On and Off at any point after finding it.


Hel's Fighters:

 An error kept the Bomber's price at 35,000 J instead of 40,000 J. The price will be kept at 35,000 J.


Options:

 Added a Gamepad Control Option to detonate rockets with the same button used to fire them.
	> Originally the plan was to also add it as a setting for Keyboard & Mouse, but I ran into space issues.
	> I cannot physically add the option unless I remove another, or place the button on top of the title.
	> Reorganizing the buttons side-by-side is not possible because pressing left/right will change the button's value.
	> If anyone is interested in this functionality for Keyboard & Mouse anyways, let me know.


Bugs:

 Fixed several dummy doors opening after the final battle in Rebel Ops, causing a crash when trying to open them.
 Fixed a crash when closing the game window during a specific bossfight in the Campaign.
	> Not critical, as it only crashed the game when closing the game.
 Fixed a specific boss in the Campaign speaking more than intended.
 Fixed a specific enemy in Rebel Ops speaking more than intended.
 Fixed Orange Disruptor Missiles not dealing damage as intended.
 Fixed Orange Disruptor Missiles changing their target's coloring erratically.
 Fixed various typos on the Hel's Fighters hub prompt screen.
 Fixed the Quad Drone's Shipyard entry.
 Fixed the Spinner II's aiming code.
 Fixed an error that caused enemies to collide with the Charge Weapon's animation.
	> This was causing a bug with the Stinger where they would stop while using the charge minigun.
	> In worse-case-scenarios, the Stinger would stop with its Energy Spike inside the player.
	> This would often lead to higher-than-intended damage output from the Stinger.


Techical Changes:

 Updated the Input library to version 6.0.4.
 Slight optimizations in the main menu code.
 If the player ends up out of bounds, they will be teleported to the closest door.
 Optimized the background management code when pausing and unpausing the game.
 Optimized the background movement code.


Steam-exclusive Changes (does not affect non-steam releases):

 Updated the icons of MF-01 Aerostrike's Achievements.
 Two achievements have been made hidden to keep their new icons a secret.


If anyone is met with any sort of weird bug, or simply thinks that the old Stinger was better, feel free to leave a comment,  send an email to the support address, or make a post in either of the Steam support threads for MF-01 Aerostrike.

notes.title: Patch Notes - Version 1.4.3
notes.notes:
​We interrupt your daily flight to bring you a new patch. This patch will be the stable release version of MF-01 Aerostrike. It mostly focuses on visual improvements, QoL features, and various optimizations. No big changes until after launch day, but Hel's Fighters is still being actively worked on.

On that note, Hel's Fighters had quite a few changes. The Gladiator had its High Explosive Shells modified. It no longer increases the overall damage of the projectile, but the AoE damage distribution was modified to be more effective against light ships and shields. Armor is resistant to the AoE effect.

Prices on the Hel's Fighters store have also been adjusted. Shield upgrades cost less, as do the Templar and Bomber. All upgrades for the Arrow D, Templar, and Bomber were modified as well. Sadly, the change is not retroactive, so you might have to restart your run to enjoy the benefits.

The last noticeable change is that the game now supports Fullscreen, Windowed, and Borderless Windowed modes, all at the same time. Previously, an engine limitation forced me to choose between Regular and Windowed mode. A recent update removed this limitation, allowing me to have both!

Here is a full list of patch notes:

Visuals:

 Increased the size of the "Damage Taken" indicator.
 The "Damage Taken" indicator will now be drawn on top of other UI elements, except the FPS counter.
 Changed the model of the Paladin's Explosive Cannon projectile.
 Reworked the visuals of the UI Healthbar.
 Reworked the Tiny and Huge UI Radar to be less small and big, respectively.
 Reworked the visuals of the Heat Gauge.
	> The color of the entire Gauge changes as the weapon heats up.
	> For charge weapons, there is one color for charging and another for fully charged.
 Reworked the visuals of the Protective Shield Duration Gauge.
	> It is now a single static color instead of a gradient.
	> The cooldown indicator that appears when the Shield is turned off remains the same.
 Moved Generators and various other gameplay objects towards the foreground when drawn.
 Adjusted the border coloring of foreground walls.
 Added a small dark spot on the borders of background window walls.


Audio:

 Increased the volume of Boss ship death explosions.


Campaign:

 Added a Docking Bay on the Viewpoint in Area 4.
 Removed a rocket pickup that spawns here during a specific event.


Hel's Fighters:

 Removed the Gladiator's High Explosive Shells damage increase.
	> Total damage per bullet to the enemy hit is now the same as without the upgrade.
	> The damage increase proved to be too strong, especially with Full-Auto Mode.
 Redistributed the Gladiator's High Explosive Shells area damage values.
	> Increased area damage vs light ships from 20 up to 30.
	> Increased area damage vs shields from 10 up to 20.
	> Decreased area damage vs armored ships from 30 down to 10.
 Changed the Arrow D's Forward Shield with a Reinforced Shield.
 The Templar's unupgraded Bouncing Plasma Cannon no longer loses damage after each bounce.
 Increased the anti-armor damage of the Bomber's Bomblet Launcher explosion from 5 up to 10.
 Reduced the price of all Enhanced Shield upgrades from 5,000 J down to 2,000 J.
 Reduced the price of the Templar from 35,000 J down to 30,000 J.
 Reduced the price of the Bomber from 45,000 J down to 35,000 J.
 Adjusted the pricing of upgrades for the Arrow D, Templar, and Bomber.
 Reduced the total shields of Shielded Breaker from 1500 down to 1200.


Shipyard:

 Added the Spinner II entry.
 Added the Sentinel Zero entry.
 Added the Shielded Breaker entry.
 Added the Gladiator entry.
 Added the Siren entry.
 Added the Arrow D entry.
 Added the Templar entry.
 Added the Bomber entry.
 Any ships you buy from Hel's Fighters will unlock its respective text entry.
	> If you already bought the ship, just select it from a blue Dock, or in the store.
	> This will make the game check if you bought the ship, and unlock its shipyard entry.


Options:

 Added a Regular Border Windowed option to the Display settings in Video Options.
 Renamed the UI Size options from Tiny and Huge to Small and Big.


Bugs:

 Fixed Spinners not having a shadow or smoking when heavily damaged.
 Fixed the Arrow D having the wrong description in the Hel's Fighters docks.
 Fixed the heat gauge of the Stinger II and Arrow D not disappearing when letting go of the trigger.


Techical Changes:

 Technical changes in preparation of Hel's Fighters Part 2.
 Improved the spawn code of the Reinforced Shield.
 Updated the Input library to version 6.0.4.
 Modified the Credits of the game, moving all links to a separate file included with the game.
 Added a new .txt file included with the game that lists all links previously found in the Credits.
 Removed old data that handled the Borderless mode.
 Optimized the firing code of the Spinner and Spinner II.
 Reworked the internal coding of the UI Healthbar.
 Reworked the internal coding of the UI Radar.
 Reworked the internal coding of the Heat Gauge.


Steam-exclusive Changes (does not affect non-steam releases):

 Opening the Steam Overlay during active gameplay now pauses the game automatically.


HOTFIX 1.4.3.1:
 Fixed an issue with Hel's special attacks not triggering correctly.

 Fixed an issue with the explosion sounds of proximity-triggered projectiles.
 Fixed health bars appearing on screenshots when UI elements were turned off.


If anyone is met with any sort of weird bug, or simply thinks that the Templar should cost more to unlock, feel free to leave a comment,  send an email to the support address, or make a post in either of the Steam support threads for MF-01 Aerostrike.

Stay safe pilots!

notes.title: Patch Notes - Version 1.4.2
notes.notes:
​We interrupt your daily flight to bring you a new patch. This patch redesigns the background walls and adds a lot of decorations all over the place. Old areas should feel a bit more detailed with Catwalks, Exposed Tubes, Vents, and various other Doodads!

Aside of decorating the various rooms in the game, a lot of Quality of Life changes have been implemented. Text windows will type at a much faster pace, and Landing Pad Interfaces had their text optimized to go by quicker.

Another neat change is being able to change your cursor color at will from the UI Settings options menu. The game will default to red, but now you can pick between 8 different colors. Choose whichever is easier for you to use.

The last major change is the addition of a voiced announcer for Hel's Fighters! He will comment on various actions during battles. In case the new voicelines are not quite to your liking, they can be turned off in the Audio Settings option menu.

Here is a full list of patch notes:

Balance:

 Increased the base rotation speed of the Aerostrike with gamepad from 6 degrees per second to 8.
 Standard weapon cooldown is no longer instant. Weapons cool down at a rate of 60 units per second.
	> For reference, a weapon's maximum heat capacity is 20 units.
	> Overheated weapons can reach up to 40 units maximum.
	> Does not affect lasers or charge weapons.


Visuals:

 Modified the look of the UI Health Bar.
 Pause Menu background inherits the coloring of the area you're currently in.
 Increased the typing speed of Text Windows.
 Increased the typing speed of Transmission Windows.
 Increased the typing speed of Landing Pad Interfaces.
 Multiple Game-wide Landing Pad Interface text modifications.
 Game-wide room modifications.
	> Some rooms had their architecture modified.
	> Some rooms had additional background doodads added.
	> Some rooms had door placement modified.


Audio:

 Direct rocket and missile impacts will have a lower pitch.
	> Only affects projectiles fired by the player.
 Added faint explosion sounds when enemy ships explode upon death.
	> This is separate from the faint explosion sounds when dying already in the game.


Campaign:

 Added a Docking Bay on the lower Gauntlet entrance in Area 1.
 Relocated a door blocker in Area 2 to Area 1.
	> This way it's located next to the new dock, preventing forced backtracking.
 Reduced the number of active Brawlers in the first Titan battle on Trial Run and Standard Test.
	> Stress Test and Trial by Fire remains unchanged.
 Added a couple of Shield Pickups to Area 3's West Storage.
 Added a couple of Shield Pickups to Area 3's East Storage.
 Changed the turrets in Area 7's lowest corridor from Flak Turrets to Plasma Turrets.


Rebel Ops:

 Renamed Act 1 to Against the Current.
	> Against the Wind clashed with Act 2's name, Second Wind.
 Modified the layout of a room in the Caves.
	> This was done after discovering that the AI patrol pathing prevented the intended stealth path from being taken.
	> Only affects Missions 3 and 9.


Hel's Fighters:

 Added a voiced announcer to the battles of Hel's Fighters.
	> He will make comments on various actions during combat.
 Slightly modified the "Last Chance" line by the Store Manager during day 1.
	> It now explicitly references the Gladiator offer.
 Added a unique ship model for the Store Owner.
 Added a unique ship model for the Manager.
 The Store Owner is now physically in the store.
	> No, you can't shoot him.


Options:

 Added a setting to toggle the Hel's Fighters Announcer on and off in Audio Settings.
 Removed the Shield Cooldown option from UI Settings.
	> Now it is always displayed on the UI and next to the cursor.
 Added a setting to change the color of the combat crosshairs in UI Settings.
	> There are 8 colors available, by default it will use Red.
 Renamed "Sensitivity" to "Rotation Speed" in the Analog Stick Settings menu.
	> The new name is more representative of how it works.
	> Its function remains the same, only the name was changed.
 Renamed "Location" to "Placement" in the Gamepad Crosshair Settings menu.
	> The new name is more representative of how it works.
	> Its function remains the same, only the name was changed.


Bugs:

 Fixed not being able to scroll back in the Screenshot Settings menu.
 Fixed the incorrect Heat Gauge offsets when using laser or charge weapons.
 Fixed the incorrect Protective Shield Cooldown indicator offset.
 Fixed an error that prevented swapping to Keyboard & Mouse by moving the mouse around.
	> If anyone wants this to be re-implemented, please let me know.
 Fixed an error in the Rebel Ops menu where Act tooltips had the wrong name for Acts 2 and 3.
 Fixed an error in the Rebel Ops menu where backing out of Act 4 would incorrectly select the Act 3 button.
 Fixed Notification Pop-ups appearing in screenshots with the UI disabled.
 Fixed the Inventory equipment title text being colored black instead of white.
 Fixed the Paintjob selection buttons changing sizes when interacted with.
 Fixed the Hel's Fighters displaying incorrectly the required currency for upgrades by a factor of 1,000.
	> Actual prices remain unchanged, we just added the ",000" at the end.


Techical Changes:

 Various minor lore and conversation text modifications throughout the game.
 Modified the cursor system to always use an in-game object.
	> This allows the cursor to dynamically scale with the resolution of the game.
 Weapon Heat and Protective Shield Cooldown indicators are now drawn on the GUI layer.
	> This allows it to properly stick to the cursor and not be obscured by other GUI elements.
	> As a bonus, it also doubles as a micro-optimization!


If anyone is met with any sort of weird bug, or simply thinks that there are not enough cursor colors, feel free to leave a comment,  send an email to the support address, or make a post in either of the Steam support threads for MF-01 Aerostrike.

Stay safe pilots!

notes.title: Patch Notes - Version 1.4.1
notes.notes:
​We interrupt your daily flight to bring you a new patch. It's the last patch before the Steam Next Fest, and it focuses on visual improvements. All menu buttons, windows, and notifications have received a face lift. Some UI elements like the Radar were also improved.

The Mouse Cursor and Weapon Crosshairs have also been updated with new models. They are slightly larger and of higher quality than the homemade ones available before. They still retain their old general shape, so it should still be clear which weapon is which.

Finally, there are a couple of minor bug fixes included. The bug that locked mouse controls during Transmissions was back, so I modified the Transmission Window code to bypass it entirely. Screenshots should display the correct weapon crosshairs now. And some tiny bugs related to Hel's Fighters were squashed as well.

Here is a full list of patch notes:

Main Menu:

 Adjusted the height of the Demo file options.
 The patch notes window is visible by default.
	> I might replace the button to toggle it on-and-off with a different function, or remove it altogether.


Visuals:

 Replaced all buttons with new sprite models.
 Replaced all windows with new sprite models.
 Replaced all notification pop-ups with new sprite models.
 Replaced all weapon crosshairs with new sprite models.
 Replaced the old mouse cursor with a new sprite model.
 Replaced the old lock-on with a new sprite model.
 Minor modification to the Hel's Fighters prompt screen model.


Options:

 Adjusted the height of the Audio Menu options.


Bugs:

 Fixed a bug where screenshots would display the wrong crosshair when using Mouse & Keyboard.
 Fixed a few more instances of mouse controls being locked off during Transmissions.
 Fixed an error that counted Spinner IIs as Spinners on the credits stats screen.
 Fixed the Hel's Fighters map pinging Arena 2 throughout Day 1.
	> It's only supposed to ping it until you complete it once.


Techical Changes:

 Modified the ending stats screen to not display Campaign-related information for Rebel Ops and Hel's Fighters.


Steam-exclusive Changes (does not affect non-steam releases):

 Added a "Wishlist on Steam" button to the main menu.


That will be the last patch for Aerostrike before Steam Next Fest begins next week. Be sure to give the new mode a try, so far it has been very well received across the board! Like I mentioned before, more content will be added to the mode in the coming weeks.

If anyone is met with any sort of weird bug, or simply thinks that the new UI should glow in the dark, feel free to leave a comment,  send an email to the support address, or make a post in either of the Steam support threads for MF-01 Aerostrike.

notes.title: Patch Notes - Version 1.4.0
notes.notes:
​We interrupt your daily flight to bring you a new patch. It adds the first part of a new game mode, Hel's Fighters. In this mode, you take part of arena combats, where Champions battle for fame, glory, and a nice sum of money.

Additionally, you can purchase various ships and upgrades to use. From the small and deadly Siren, to the almighty Bomber. This part includes the first 4 days of Hel's Fighters, and is available to play in the Demo. You can find Hel's Fighters in the Main Menu, right under Rebel Ops.

Other additions include two new paintjobs. One is the Iron Pekin, a reward for the Rubber Ducks community after succeeding in the Rubber Ducks Challenge 3 event held in May. The second new paintjob is called Alliance, the most colorfully varied paintjob in the game to date.

Moving on, you can now freely swap between Gamepad and Mouse & Keyboard controls. Just use whichever you want, and the game will automatically adjust itself. No more need to plug and unplug your controller.

Finally, a lot of small but significant changes and improvements have been made. Steam Input has been enabled for PS controllers, as there seems to be an issue with games not detecting them correctly. A slippery bug with Transmissions was fixed. And you can now adjust the size of enemy combat dialogue.

Here is a full list of patch notes:

Additions:

 Added a new gamemode: Hel's Fighters
	> You'll be part of an arena battle show, where Champions fight for fame, glory, and money!
	> It can be accessed from the Main Menu, right under Rebel Ops.
	> This mode is a work-in-progress. Further features and content will be added later.


Visuals:

 Modified the writing of Notification Windows in Spanish to fit gamepad button names.
 The selected Aerostrike paintjob will be displayed during Transmissions in the Campaign.
 Transmission windows now have a semi-transparent background.
 Containers now have a brighter-colored entrance.


Campaign:

 Adjusted the size of the surface corridor room in Area 1 to prevent visual glitches with the background.


Rebel Ops:

 Updated the map key to not label the player's ship as an Aerostrike.
 Added broken-through decoration walls to a room in the Mines.
 You can now change difficulty mid-mission.
	> Same rules apply as the Campaign, Challenges are awarded based off the lowest difficulty you played on.


Story:

 Clicking on a text entry button a second time skips the "writing" animation.


Shipyard:

 Clicking on a text entry button a second time skips the "writing" animation.
 Added a new free paintjob: Iron Pekin.
 Added a new free paintjob: Alliance.
	> You may find them in the Free Paint Job section of the Aerostrike's Shipyard submenu.

	
Challenge:

 Updated the description of the Taxonomist challenge.
	> Now it specifies you need to destroy at least 30 different ships.
	> This was done in anticipation of Hel's Fighters adding a handful of new ships.


Options:

 Added a Dialogue setting to increase the font size of the enemy dialogue text.
 Combined the Volume and Audio menus into a single Audio menu.
	> Inside the Audio menu, you can find two submenus: Volume, and Ambience and Menu.
 Saving option setting changes now displays a text confirmation above the save button.
 You can now scroll option settings by using left and right input keys and buttons.
 Added the ability to scroll backwards through option settings by using right-click, or using left input keys and buttons.


Bugs:

 Fixed Aria's map button hotkey reminder indicating the wrong value for gamepads.
 Fixed mouse controls sometimes being locked off during Transmissions.
 Attempt to fix a bug that prevented PS4 and PS5 controllers from being detected.


Techical Changes:

 Updated the Forward Shield description to include that you cannot use weapons while it's active.
 Trying to swap weapons with only one weapon in your inventory now displays the weapon in the UI.
 Locking the mouse to the game window now only takes effect during active gameplay.
	> The mouse will remain unlocked while browsing menus or when the game is paused.
 Removed Rubber Ducks Challenge 3 assets to free up space.
 Updated the Input library to version 5.6.1.
 Modified the input device code to allow for hotswapping between gamepad and keyboard & mouse controls.
	> Now instead of having to plug/unplug a gamepad, you can simply use your prefered input device and the game will swap automatically.


Steam-exclusive Changes (does not affect non-steam releases):

 Enabled the use of Steam Input for MF-01 Aerostrike.
 Increased the number of files stored on Steam Cloud for the Hel's Fighters mode.


Like I said before, Hel's Fighters will get more content down the line. There are currently plans for two more parts of content being added, and a few small patches in-between that will improve the experience. One of the pending changes is to have a fully voiced announcer for battles!

If anyone is met with any sort of weird bug, or simply thinks that the Brawler's Underdog bonus is not good enough, feel free to leave a comment,  send an email to the support address, or make a post in either of the Steam support threads for MF-01 Aerostrike.

Stay safe pilots!

notes.title: Patch Notes - Version 1.3.9
notes.notes:

Additionally, most weapons in the game have received new models. They are now more detailed and have a light glow around them. Lasers are also more detailed and less pixelated while aiming diagonally. Rockets are still the same, perhaps they'll also be updated in the future.

Visuals:

 Added brand new models to most weapons in the game.
 Added an in-game notification when completing Challenges.


Options:

	> This options is turned on by default, and can be found in Options > Keyboard > Control Options.
	> When using a gamepad, the mouse is automatically unlocked.


Bugs:

 Fixed switching from Fullscreen to Windowed mode for the first time causing the game window to be misaligned.
 Fixed a bug that would crash the game when disconnecting a gamepad on the Title Screen.
 Fixed a bug where background music would overlap when opening the Rebel Ops menu for the first time.
 Fixed a minor coding bug with the Dev room.


Techical Changes:

	> This change will only take effect when first starting the game, or when deleting existing Option settings.


Steam-exclusive Changes (does not affect non-steam releases):

 Updated the Steamworks Extension to version 1.4.3.


If anyone is met with any sort of weird bug, or simply thinks that energy projectiles should have bloom and chromatic aberration, feel free to leave a comment,  send an email to the support address, or make a post in either of the Steam support threads for MF-01 Aerostrike.

notes.title: Patch Notes - Version 1.3.8
notes.notes:
​We interrupt your daily flight to bring you a new patch. It adds the new Challenge menu, a section where you can review all challenges in the game, as well as sort them by completion status. You can also view and switch to any unlocked paintjobs here.

​The Shipyard was also updated to only display unlocked paintjobs. This should make it easier to browse between all 50 available paintjobs in Aerostrike.

Additionally, new high resolution settings have been added to the Video section of the Options menu. You can go all the way up to 4K! However, the game will also cap the available resolutions to the physical monitor's own resolution.

Finally, some minor audio and visual changes were added to Generators and Doors, and a lot of bugs have been squashed.

Here is a full list of patch notes:

Additions:

 Added a new Challenge menu. It is available under Info.
	> You can view all Aerostrike challenges here, both completed and pending.
	> You can also see what Paintjob each challenge rewards, and switch to it once unlocked.


Visuals:

 Improved the Generator's animation.
 Improved the inside of Containers.
 Added a tiny animation to Open doors.
	> The green "open" light will brighten and dim in a loop.
	> No other door has an animation.


Audio:

 Added a cue sound when charging and draining Generators.
 Added a humming sound to Generators.
	> The pitch of the sound is affected by the energy level.


Shipyard:

 The Paintjob submenus now only display unlocked paintjobs.
	> This should make it easier to browse between available paintjobs


Options:

 The game now automatically caps the resolution options to the resolution of the physical computer monitor, up to 4K.
 Added three higher resolution settings in the Video Options menu.
	> The new resolutions are: 2560x144, 3200x1800, and 3840x2160


Bugs:

 Fixed a bug with the Stinger while trying to use Boost Thrusters with the Toggle option.
 Fixed a crash when trying to take a screenshot while the game was paused.
 Fixed a bug where several particles would not appear correctly.
 Fixed a bug where the Scout 2's Plasma Machine Gun was not properly inheriting vertical momentum.
 Fixed the Training Arena Settings menu not properly displaying the names of the CQC and Sectioned arenas.
 Fixed a minor bug where the 1366x768 resolution was not saving correctly.
	> For anyone using this resolution, you can fix the issue post-update by simply saving the Video Options. There's no need to change anything.


Techical Changes:

 Made multiple background changes in preparation for Hel's Fighters.
	> Should not impact gameplay.


If anyone is met with any sort of weird bug, or simply thinks that the game should support 8K resolution, feel free to leave a comment,  send an email to the support address, or make a post in either of the Steam support threads for MF-01 Aerostrike.

Stay safe pilots!

notes.title: Patch Notes - Version 1.3.7
notes.notes:
We interrupt your daily flight to bring you a new patch. It adds the new Screenshot System, a new free paintjob for the Aerostrike, and several visual and technical improvements.

​Additionally, two new arenas have been added to the Training Room, which itself has also gone through some minor changes.

Here is a full list of patch notes:

Additions:

 Added a built-in screenshot function. Press the Screenshot button to take a picture of the game at any time!
 	> Default Keyboard bind: F12 (press)
 	> Default Gamepad bind: SELECT (hold)


Visuals:

 Increased the size of the default UI Health Bar by 50%.
 	> Tiny and Huge UI Health Bar remains unchanged.
 UI Health Bar background is now semi-transparent.


Training:

 Added an "Entrance" room to the Training area.
 	> Selecting the Training area from the main menu will now spawn you here instead of the Combat Settings room.
 Removed the Dock in the Combat Settings room of the Training area.
 Entering the Combat Settings room will now automatically repair all damage and restore all ammunition.
 Modified the equipment order inside the Armory.
 Added two new training arenas: CQC and Sectioned.


Shipyard:

 Added a new free paint job: Potatostrike.
 	> You may find it in the Free Paint Job section of the Aerostrike's Shipyard submenu.


Options:

 Added a Screenshot options submenu, under Interface. Here you can change various Screenshot-related settings.
 	> You can enable or disable the Screenshot system as a whole.
 	> You can select whether to show or hide the UI when taking screenshots.
 	> You can add a delay timer to screenshots. Works on Steam too.
 	> You can change the Keyboard bind for taking Screenshots.
 	> You can change which button to hold on the Gamepad to take a screenshot


Bugs:

 Fixed a bug where the Huge UI would not properly display healthbars upon death.
 Fixed Landing Pad Interfaces not having their "Close" button localized.
 Fixed the Back/Cancel button of the Volume Options submenu not updating correctly after saving all changes.
 Fixed a bug that prevented the "Cancel" key/button from being properly rebound.


Techical Changes:

 Slightly improved the code of the UI health bar.
 Slightly improved the code of the ship health bar display (the one that appears underneath a ship).


​If anyone is met with any sort of weird bug, or simply thinks that the enemies should also have a Potato model, feel free to leave a comment,  send an email to the support address, or contact me via twitter.

Stay safe pilots!

notes.title: Patch Notes - Version 1.3.6
notes.notes:
We interrupt your daily flight to bring a new patch. This adds Cloud Storage support for the Demo, and the base code for Achievements.

​Additionally, it fixes a few minor bugs, improves the code of various weapons and health bars, updates the Input library, and adds a few visual improvements.

Here is a full list of patch notes:

Visuals:

 Moved the Patch Notes window to a lower layer.
	This should prevent it from obscuring tooltip text.
 Added shadows to Shield and Rocket pickups.
 Security Scanners will now create scan particles around the Aerostrike.


Campaign:

 Made a few modifications to the final boss battle for storytelling purposes.
	Should not impact gameplay negatively.
 	Currently unavailable in the Steam version of the game.


Bugs:

 Fixed a crash if you closed the game during the final boss battle of the Campaign.
 Fixed blocked doors in the Demo map appearing as "Unopened" instead of "Blocked".
 Fixed the background vignette appearing over the background walls in certain rooms on Rebel Ops.
 Fixed the background vignette appearing over the Behemoth.


Techical Changes:

 Updated the Input library to version 5.5.2.
 Improved the internal coding of the Security Scanners.
 Modified the internal coding of proximity-triggered projectiles.
 Modified the internal coding of rocket and missile projectiles.
 Modified the internal coding of ship health bars.


Steam-exclusive Changes:

 Enabled Cloud Storage for the Demo of the game.
 Added the base code for Steam Achievements for the full version of the game.
	Does not impact the Demo version.
	Any achievements earned on the Demo will be rewarded when booting the full version of the game.


​If anyone is met with any sort of weird bug, or simply thinks that Security Scanners need double the current amount of particles, feel free to leave a comment,  send an email to the support address, or contact me via twitter.

Stay safe pilots!
